column1: # E-2 role labels (the oracle): corpus, file, definition name, role. Made by hand
# from the sources (2026-11-19), before any predicate was run. Every definition of
# that name in that file gets the role. Roles follow the BLIS decomposition:
#   driver       the blocking loops over nc, kc, mc panels that call packing and the macro-kernel
#   pack         copies a block of A or B into a contiguous buffer
#   macrokernel  the loops over nr, mr tiles around the micro-kernel
#   microkernel  computes one mr x nr tile of C from packed panels
#   naive        an unblocked loop nest computing C (no packing, no tiling)
# Octavian.jl 83f70f1b (GitHub master, 2025-10-21). Its micro-kernel is generated
# by LoopVectorization from the @turbo loops of the macro-kernels: none in source.
# LinearAlgebra matmul.jl, Julia 1.13.1 stdlib: no blocking or packing at all.
